justification: GO-Science p.30: AI pushes unemployment to recession-era levels by 2030. The slump is sized so the youth NEET rate in 2030/31 is 1.7 points above the model's no-AI rate. This is the average rise in 2009-11 compared with 2007-08 (ONS NEET table 1: 13.9% to 15.6%). target_neet_rate (the 2009-11 level, 15.6%) is used only as a sensitivity

GO-Science p.33: AI pushes unemployment above recession levels by 2030 and entry-level recruitment collapses, while GDP grows fast. The slump is sized so the youth NEET rate in 2030/31 is 3.0 points above the model's no-AI rate. This is the rise from the 2007-08 average (13.9%) to the Jul-Sep 2011 peak (16.9%). target_neet_rate (16.9%) is used only as a sensitivity
